title.narrative: Promote Equitable Climate Action in IPs

description.narrative: My Village Organization (MVI) proposes to take project actions for three CPAs in five villages, three communes in Koh Nhek district, Mondulkiri province. Goal of the project is to reduce carbon emissions through reforestation and agroforestry initiatives, sustainable livelihoods in CPAs and RGC accountability for its Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC). To reach the project goal, there are 3 main objectives have been composed in consultation with the communities which are 1) to increase the performance of the forest dependent communities toward forest resource protection through reforestation and agroforestry initiatives. 2) to increase the capacities of forest dependent communities for CO2 measurement activities. And 3) to increase the capacities of local communities on the Government's NDC and their contribution to mitigating climate change. The project is expected to benefit to 4112 people, 1179 women,3906 indigenous people (approximately), 2878 indigenous youths, 8 people with disabilities in six villages 3 communes, 1 district, Mondulkiri province

participating-org.narrative: My Village (MVi) was founded in November 2006 and officially registered with the Ministry of Interior in 25 January 2007. Ever since, MVi became a recognized local NGO working for Indigenous Peoples' Rights and Natural Resources Management. MVi encourages ownership and participation of Indigenous Peoples# as its approaches to protect their land and natural resources. MVi is operating in Northeast provinces of Cambodia, in particular in Mondulkiri, Kratie and Stung Treng, and focused on organizing community forests, helping indigenous people learn about their rights, helping women become empowered, and facilitating communities in undertaking various development projects. MVi has been worked in collaboration with Community Networks, Provincial and National NGO networks, and line of government institutions at the national and provincial level of Department of Local Administrative of Ministry of Interior, Department of Forestry Administrative, Department of Agriculture, Department of Environment, Department of Land Use Management, and Department of Rural Development.
